'''KU-Flora''' is an NPC in {{Location|Black Shores}}.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''[[Fran]]:''' I've never seen a plant rooted in the Tacetite before.
:'''KU-Flora:''' Ku—Plants that grow on the Tacetite will slowly lose their pigmentation until they turn purple or white.
:'''KU-Flora:''' No matter what you do, you can't find plants in any other colors here.
:'''KU-Flora:''' Maybe your hair would turn purple or white too. Ku ku ku...
:{{DIcon}} Me too...?
:'''KU-Flora:''' Just kidding! You're human, not a plant. Ku ku ku...
:'''Fran:''' But actually, without protective gear, humans could be affected by the Tacetite's frequency and start showing symptoms like ataxia.
:'''Fran:''' However, the Black Shores members don't seem to experience that issue.
:'''KU-Flora:''' Ku— That's because we have the Anchors. Without them, the Black Shores would just be a barren island.
:'''KU-Flora:''' And a barren island would have no use of a gardener like me, ku ku...
:'''Fran:''' So... the Anchors are like one giant protective device for the Black Shores?
:'''KU-Flora:''' Ku... Help me water these flowers first, and then I'll answer your question in exchange. And you over there, wanna give it a try too?
:{{DIcon}} Thanks, but I'll pass.
:{{DIcon}} Turning over rocks for Astrites is more of my thing.
----
;(During {{Quest|To the Shore's End}})
:'''KU-Flora:''' Beep beep! This is an emergency!
:'''KU-Flora:''' Entry into the corruption area without proper protection or a Terminal robot escort is not recommended!
{{Dialogue End}}
